summary: Pedagogical Opponent Feature Testing - All 15 backend tests passed (2 skipped). Frontend components verified working. EvalBar shows evaluation and has hidden state support. ConsequenceFeedback component ready for pedagogical move responses.
critical_code_review_comments: PedagogicalOpportunityService correctly implements 0% probability in opening, 25% in middlegame
Eval sacrifice range for intermediate players is correctly set to 0.3-1.5 pawns
CoachGameSession dataclass has all required pedagogical fields
EvalBar component correctly handles hidden prop with '?' display and amber pulsing animation
ConsequenceFeedback component has proper data-testid and displays found/missed opportunity feedback
CoachPlay.jsx correctly integrates hideEvalBar state and consequenceFeedback state
Session state API returns pedagogical state (hide_eval, opportunities_found, opportunities_missed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pedagogical Opponent feature verified. Key findings: 1) Backend service correctly implements phase-based probability (0% opening, 25% middlegame). 2) Eval sacrifice ranges are correctly configured (0.3-1.5 pawns for intermediate). 3) Session tracks pedagogical state (opportunities_found, opportunities_missed). 4) Frontend EvalBar has hidden prop that shows '?' with amber animation. 5) ConsequenceFeedback component displays when user responds to pedagogical move. 6) The feature uses random.random() < 0.25 so pedagogical moves won't occur every time - this is by design.

eval_bar_component.normal_display: Shows evaluation score with color coding

consequence_feedback_component.missed_opportunity_display: Amber 'Missed Opportunity' with X, shows expected move

coach_play_integration.pedagogical_hint_overlay: Shows 'Find the opportunity!' when eval hidden

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real, no mocking

test_notes.statistical_nature: Pedagogical moves use random.random() < 0.25, so they won't occur every game. Testing verified the capability exists and probability is correctly configured.
test_notes.skipped_tests: 2 tests skipped because game-phase endpoint is not directly exposed (phase detection tested via session state instead)
